column1: # One model-checking run per row. bin/verify runs them all.
# check      name of the row. A "mutant-" row is a deliberately broken variant
#            of the model, there to show that the rule can fail. A "finding-"
#            row is a rule the current code breaks. There are none right now.
# keys       number of keys in the transaction
# fails      a datastore call can fail without writing
# lostat     call sites where a write can land and still report an error
# crashes    the coordinating server can stop at any step
# declines   an update function can return nil
# impatient  a resolver can abort the tx while the coordinator still runs
# mutant     "none", or a broken variant defined in DropTx.tla
# rule       the invariant of DropTx.tla to check
